common.homeTitle: Family Tree Studio — {page}. Go to the home page

home.title: Online Family Tree Maker: Build It and Print It Large
home.description: Build your family tree in the browser and print it on a large canvas, up to A0. Opens GEDCOM files from MyHeritage, Gramps, Ancestry and other genealogy software.
home.noscript: Family Tree Studio lets you build your family tree and print a chart of it on a large canvas. JavaScript must be enabled.
home.name: Family Tree Studio
home.features: Build a family tree right on the chart, Checks for mistakes in dates and links, Chart of the whole tree for large-format printing from A3 to A0, GEDCOM import and export, Data stays on the user's computer
home.imageAlt: Family Tree Studio — build your family tree and print it on a large canvas

editor.title: Online Family Tree Editor — Family Tree Studio
editor.description: Build your family tree right on the chart: parents, spouses, children, dates and places. Mistakes are flagged, and the result is saved as GEDCOM.
editor.noscript: The Family Tree Studio editor: add relatives right on the tree and save the result as GEDCOM. JavaScript must be enabled to use the editor.
editor.name: Family Tree Studio Editor
editor.features: Add relatives right on the tree, Checks for mistakes in dates and links, Search across thousands of people, GEDCOM 5.5.1 and 7.0 import and export
editor.imageAlt: Family Tree Studio family tree editor

viewer.title: Large Printable Family Tree Chart from GEDCOM — Family Tree Studio
viewer.description: Open a GEDCOM file and see your whole family tree on one chart. Adjust the look and save it for printing on a large canvas, up to A0.
viewer.noscript: The Family Tree Studio chart: open a GEDCOM file from any genealogy program and save a chart of the whole tree for printing on a large canvas. JavaScript must be enabled.
viewer.name: Family Tree Studio Chart
viewer.imageAlt: Family Tree Studio family tree chart
viewer.features: The whole tree on one canvas, Adjustable colors and layout, JPEG export for printing from A3 to A0 and 4K, GEDCOM files from MyHeritage, Gramps, Ancestry and other software

landing.title: Put your family's story together
landing.intro: Two tools for your family tree: one to build it, the other to get it ready for printing on a large canvas.
landing.editorHint: This is where you build the tree: add relatives and note who is whose parent, spouse or child.
landing.viewerHint: Shows the whole tree on one chart that you can save and print on a large canvas.
landing.privacy: Your tree is stored only on your own computer.
landing.gedcom: Already keep a tree in MyHeritage, Gramps or Ancestry? Save it as a GEDCOM file and it will open here.

defaults.demoNote: A fictional family tree for getting to know the editor. All people and events are generated automatically.

startup.failedTitle: Could not open the saved tree
startup.failedHint: The saved data was not overwritten. Check that the browser allows this site to store data.

welcome.title: Bring your family tree into digital form
welcome.intro: Add people right on the tree: parents, spouses, children — in one click or with one key. Surnames and dates are prefilled, and the result is saved as GEDCOM, which every genealogy program understands.
welcome.newHint: With yourself or with the oldest known ancestor
welcome.openHint: .ged from MyHeritage, Gramps, Ancestry and others
welcome.privacy: Everything is stored only in this browser. Nothing is sent over the internet.

shortcuts.label: Keys
shortcuts.title: Working from the keyboard
shortcuts.intro: Letter keys work in any keyboard layout when the cursor is not in a text field. The mouse wheel or touchpad moves the tree; Ctrl + wheel or pinch zooms.
shortcuts.search: Find a person or a command

snapshots.title: Autosaved versions
snapshots.intro: Every 10 minutes of work and before a tree is replaced, a copy is saved in this browser. Restoring replaces the current tree (a copy of it is saved too).

issues.intro: Hints that help catch transcription mistakes. They never block saving.
issues.noneHint: Dates, links and names look consistent.
